item.title: Premium Candle Product Shot

turns.text: Make a product shot of a scented candle. Make it look premium.

item.tests: Resolves a vague premium-style brief through reasonable visual choices without unnecessary clarification.
must_haves: A candle is clearly recognizable and is the dominant subject.
The candle and its container have clean, well-defined edges without obvious distortions.
The composition is uncluttered, with no distracting household objects.
Controlled lighting and a coordinated background present the candle as a polished retail product.

turns.text: I'd like you to make a product shot for me. I've been thinking about how to present this and am probably overthinking it a little. The product is a scented candle, which is the thing I want the shot to feature. I want it to look premium.

dialog.agent:
Please upload a photo of the candle so I can feature your actual product and preserve its label.

For a premium look, I’d suggest **warm ivory tones, a stone surface, soft directional lighting, and subtle shadows**, with the candle as the clear focal point. If you share the scent, I can tailor the styling to match.
dialog.why: It asks the user to upload a candle photo and optionally share the scent before proceeding.
dialog.user: Please go ahead and create the scented candle rather than working from a product photo; the container, brand, and label wording are all your call. You can choose the scent and styling too, since my main goal is simply a premium-looking product shot. The aspect ratio is also up to you—I’m probably overthinking the presentation a little.

approvals.name: generate_image

args.name: AURE — Cedar & Fig Premium Candle Product Shot

style.prompt: Create a photorealistic luxury scented candle advertising product photograph, square composition. One single premium candle is the unmistakable hero, generously sized in the frame with comfortable negative space. Thick smoked amber glass cylindrical vessel with a subtly heavy glass base, ivory soy wax and a single unlit dark wick visible from a slightly elevated front three-quarter camera angle. Elegant matte warm-ivory paper label perfectly centered on the front, minimal editorial typography, exact legible label wording on three lines: 'AURE' in refined widely spaced uppercase serif lettering, 'CEDAR & FIG' in small uppercase lettering, 'SCENTED CANDLE · 220 g' in tiny tasteful type. No other text. Place the candle on a warm honed travertine block, against a seamless warm ivory plaster background. A tiny out-of-focus fig leaf far in the background provides a restrained scent cue without distracting from the product. Sophisticated soft directional window light from upper left, natural long soft shadows falling right, delicate glass reflections, tactile paper and stone textures, rich amber tones, warm neutral palette, subtle tonal depth. High-end still-life art direction, believable physically accurate materials, medium-format commercial photography, 85mm lens appearance, sharp label and vessel, gently softened background. Understated, timeless, expensive, impeccably clean and uncluttered. No people, no hands, no additional candles, no packaging, no floating objects, no watermark, no superimposed promotional text.
